target: Individually reconstruct and verify every visible building on Al Mashaya, Al Gomhouria and the university corridor against current location-matched references.

statusDefinitions.unreferenced: Mapped or inferred massing with procedural detail; no individual facade comparison.
statusDefinitions.photo-referenced: A specific real structure has been located and modeled using identified photographs. Dimensions and unobserved details may remain estimated. This does not establish an exact match.
statusDefinitions.survey-verified: Reserved for measured geometry, complete dated exterior coverage and a recorded independent comparison. A photograph alone cannot establish this status.

entries.name: Yamama Tower — Metro / Coffee Wizard frontage
entries.heightSource: Retained inferred map massing (26.4 m), not a measured height. Six full residential tiers and a cropped upper tier are visible; the photograph does not establish total floor count or roof height.

frontage.propTreatment: Omit invented palms, furniture and static people in the photographed street-facing strip. This removes unsupported decoration; it does not verify a complete current street-furniture inventory.

geolocation.orientation: North frontage toward Lower Al Mashaya and the Nile. The business pin falls in the street north of this footprint. The official branch address and Nile-facing terrace photograph corroborate the block and orientation; exact shared-shop fascia extents remain uncertain.

references.view: Street-facing central cream/peach facade, Metro fascia, Coffee Wizard, arches and residential balconies; top cropped

references.supports: Listing places the property above Metro, Lower Al Mashaya; listing date is not a photo capture date.
Official branch registration identifies Coffee Wizard on first floor, Yamama Tower, Lower Al Mashaya extension.
